_README: Ground truth for measuring extraction quality:
python dev-server.py --test test-datasheets
KEYS are a distinctive fragment of the PDF filename - the product code is
ideal. Matching is loose and case-insensitive, so renaming a file will not
silently stop it being scored. A sheet with no entry here says so.
VALUES are what SHOULD land in each column. "UNKNOWN" means the cell should
come back BLANK - the sheet gives no value, or gives two or more and picking
one is the engineer's job. Those are as important as the filled ones and are
what the tool is worst at.
Scoring is substring-based, so values are kept short and distinctive.
DIMENSIONS are stored as the single most characteristic figure because axis
labelling varies between the tool and the sheet; two-digit dimensions are
omitted entirely since "70" also matches "170mm". Treat dimension scoring
as indicative.
Fields are OMITTED where the correct answer is genuinely doubtful - omitted
fields are not scored, and that is the right outcome for a doubtful reading.
DRIVER CONVENTION: where a sheet states 'Dimming: Non-Dimming' these expect
NON-DIMMING rather than blank, since that is a stated single value. If your
schedule would rather leave that column empty, change these to UNKNOWN.
All entries were read off the PDFs by hand. Check them before trusting the
score - a wrong expected value makes a correct extraction look like a bug.

modular-kup-72._note: Family sheet: 4 CCTs, 3 drive currents, 6 finishes. Dimensions exist only on the drawing. CRI 98 'on request' is the decoy against the stated Min. 90.

SLI10003._note: Ligman SLIMSOFT bollard. Single variant, everything stated. The regex scanner missed IP, finish and SDCM despite all three being printed plainly.

LUO65010._note: Versalux Lucca. THE DIMENSIONS TRAP: 'Luminous Length 628mm' sits above 'Dimensions 650mm'. 628 is the lit area, 650 is the fitting.

PW69-GP108._note: Ligman POWERVISION 6. The hardest sheet here: two CCTs, a lumen RANGE, three dimming types, eleven colours, no mounting stated. FIVE fields must come back blank.

EL-DENL-3100-000._note: Eagle Densus. MOUNTING TRAP: 'Suspended/Surface Mounted' is two options, so mounting is blank AND description must not say suspended - it is a batten. Four lifetime metrics of one product: take L90B50.

SL29.06._note: iGuzzini Clan table lamp. Nothing stated for CRI, SDCM, lifetime or voltage - all four must be blank. 'Power supply cable with plug' is not a voltage. Height 384mm exists only on the drawing.

118-COTP30W603._note: FAZE Core 95 Plus Track. 'Dimming: Non-Dimming' with 'Dali Available: Yes' three rows below - available is not fitted. Dimensions only on the drawing.

118-COTP316B603._note: FAZE Core 70 Plus Track. Control Gear row says Non-Dimmable and Dimming says Non-Dimming, but Dali Available says Yes. Dimensions omitted: the drawing's O70mm would also match the 170mm H2 figure.

118-COR318B604D._note: FAZE Core G3 surface cylinder. Control Gear row states DALI, which resolves the vague 'Dimming determined by driver'. Mounting omitted: it is a surface cylinder by form but no mounting row states it, and the overview offers adjustable/suspension/track as options.

7-BLF204W403._note: FAZE Bloc 2. LIFETIME TRAP: '54,000 hrs' with no L figure at all, so lifetime must be blank. Dimensions omitted - the table says Width 45mm while the drawing says W 70mm, an internal contradiction.

10-FL1220SSTW._note: FAZE Flow Side TUNABLE WHITE. Source must be blank: CCT is printed 'N/AK' and the strip shifts across 2700K-5300K, which is a range not a value. Dimming row reads 'determined by driver', which is not a value either.

10-FPSR1035._note: FAZE Flow Plus Side. Non-Dimming stated while Dali Available says Yes. Source omitted: 'Watt/m 10W p/m' is a per-metre figure, not this run's circuit watts.

118-ED2A13W603._note: FAZE Edge Wall Washer. Cut Out O92mm must not become the dimensions - envelope is O100mm. Phase Cut Dimming stated while Dali Available says Yes. Description must be DOWNLIGHT, not 'wall washer'.

118-ED3L13W603._note: FAZE Edge 100 G3. UGR 15 must not be read as CRI (92+). Control Gear DALI resolves the vague 'Dimming determined by driver'.

118-ED3X13W603._note: FAZE Edge XS. Hardest dimension case in the set: the drawing carries CUTOUT O92, inner trim O62, outer O103 and H 83. The envelope is 103, so both 92 and 62 are wrong.

119-ARKW18B803._note: FAZE Ark Wall. Lifetime '55,000hrs' with no L figure, so blank. UGR 20 and IP Rating 20 must not be confused with CRI 90+. Overview prose says 'brushed bronze' but the Finish row says Black - the spec row wins.

119-BL12815CSG3._note: FAZE Bloom pendant. '>72,000hrs L70' does carry an L figure so it is NOT blank. Overview offers Champagne & Carbon finishes but the Finish row states Carbon Smoke for this variant - the stated row wins. Dimensions omitted: the drawing is a low-res raster whose labels are illegible.

121-DARC2BL._note: FAZE Darc cordless table lamp. Lifetime '55,000hrs' has no L figure. No Colour Deviation row exists at all. USB-C charging is not a voltage. Mounting omitted - never stated.

A3130021NT._note: iGuzzini Puck Recessed. Dimming 'DALI / Push' is two options so driver is blank. Recess O59 is a cut-out and packaging 139x133x59 is packaging - neither is the dimensions.

A5721000WT._note: iGuzzini Enso. 'No Dim' -> NON-DIMMING. Recess 35x122 and packaging 170x127x99 are both decoys against the drawing's 140x135. Mounting omitted: category says wall but the variant is semi-recessed.

A3080010NT._note: iGuzzini Rec Mini. Dimensions only on the drawing (176x148x40); packaging 232x190x48 is the decoy.

A2880011NT._note: iGuzzini Lip. Dimming 'DALI / Push' is two options so driver is blank. Drawing 232x90x60 against packaging 273x143x75.

SM-21141._note: Ligman SMITH. Two CCTs plus a 7876-8468 lumen range so source is blank; 5 standard + 7 special finishes so finish is blank; 'On/Off, 1-10V, DALI' is three options. CRI is 80 in both CCT variants so it survives. BUG B2-U5-G3 and CIE flux code 67 are CRI decoys.

EDB-20001._note: Ligman EDINBURGH. Three CCTs plus a 2528-3404 lm range so source is blank; full palette so finish is blank. CRI 80 across all three CCTs so it survives. A required 3m pole accessory is not a mounting method.

LD50011._note: Ligman LADOR 2. Palette plus 'special finishes upon request' so finish is blank; '3000K CRI80, 4000K CRI80' and a 906-1112 lm range so source is blank, yet CRI is 80 either way. Three lifetime rows are one product measured three ways - take L90B10. A ground spike accessory is not a mounting method.

SV30.F5._note: iGuzzini iWay Velvet. CRI 82 must not be confused with the Rf 80 / Rg 101 gamut codes. Two lifetime rows (Ta25 / Ta40) are one product measured twice.

BJ93.15._note: iGuzzini iPro. Driver must be blank: Class III is not a voltage, the ballast is ordered separately, and 1050mA is drive current not supply. Mounting omitted - the sheet genuinely offers ground, wall or ceiling.

BE16.04._note: iGuzzini Lun-Up Evo in-ground. Driver is 24V from the headline, NOT DALI - the DALI ballast is ordered separately. The 195x61x38 figure on page 1 is the optional remote power supply, not the fitting.

COMLALFR00._note: Versalux Como ALAV L. Luminous Length/Width 150mm is the LIT AREA; the Physical panel gives 250mm x 130mm. Cut Out 225mm is a cut-out. IP omitted: printed as 'IP20 / IP65 from underside', genuinely two-valued.

COMS0000WB._note: Versalux Como S. Luminous 90mm is the lit area, real envelope is 110mm x 75mm, Cut Out 98mm is a cut-out. No L-rating anywhere so lifetime is blank despite a 5 year warranty.
